description.value: Blue Grouse Country Inn is a four-room, first-class guest house established in 2001 on 26 treed acres within Wells Gray Park near Clearwater, BC. Each room features en-suite bath, satellite TV, bar fridge, and in-room coffee bar, while a shared kitchen and outdoor BBQ support self-catering guests. The inn is affiliated with BC Backcountry Adventures Ltd. and sits close to Helmcken Falls, Moul Falls, and extensive hiking and mountain biking trails throughout the park.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and consistent with OSM tags: address, phone, and website all match. The rooms-and-services page confirms laundry ('laundry service for an additional charge with sufficient notice') and Wi-Fi ('wireless high speed internet' in every room). No mention of bike storage, e-bike charging, or any cycle-specific infrastructure appears anywhere on the site; those fields default to null. The OSM email (info@bluegrousecountryinn.com) differs from the reservation email used consistently across all website pages (reservation@bluegrousecountryinn.com), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM email (info@bluegrousecountryinn.com) differs from the reservation email used consistently on the website (reservation@bluegrousecountryinn.com).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate accommodation in an excellent cycling destination (Wells Gray Park), but neither required criterion — secure bike storage nor staff bike procedure — is addressed anywhere on the website. Direct outreach is needed to confirm cycling-specific suitability before including in the WWC directory.

Laundry.detail: Laundry service offered with sufficient notice for an additional charge
